demo.bannerBody: Demo workspace: no real analysis is started, and {{copilot}}’s answers are prepared in advance. The dossiers cover real companies, from public information: this is a sample set, not your real portfolio.

entry.introBody: The dossiers you are about to open cover REAL companies, built from public information — that is exactly what the product does. Only one account is fictional, the one carrying missions and invoicing, and its name says so. Explore freely.

highlights.accounts: Five complete conquest dossiers: signals, group entities, action plan.
highlights.contacts: Decision-makers, their org chart and enriched contact details.
highlights.actions: Ready-to-send outreach messages, and {{copilot}} to help.

entry.startForfaitHint: A second workspace: projects to scope and won fixed-price projects followed, staffing in the background.
entry.introFootnote: No analysis re-run, no account to create.

form.title: Before you start the demo
form.subtitle: A few details to help us understand your context and support you after you discover {{brand}}.
form.footnote: This information lets us follow up with you, answer your questions, and suggest the offer best suited to your organization. No commitment. In the demo you enter under a fictional sample-salesperson profile: that is its name, not yours, that you will see in the room. The identity entered here is only used to get back to you, it does not appear in the records.
